{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the issue with revenue: it's strings with commas
print("Sample of revenue before parsing:")
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm parsing worked
print("Sample of revenue after parsing:")
print(sales['revenue'].head())"}
